arguments.title: V-JEPA 2.1: Unlocking Dense Features in Video Self-Supervised Learning
key_claims: Supervising visible as well as masked tokens and intermediate layers improves dense video features alongside global tasks. The released80M ViT-B/16 provides a specific future temporal teacher. Use a frozen model if pursued; do not port its large-scale pretraining recipe into this project. Keep explicit chromatic targets because video understanding scores do not establish color faithfulness. Published robotics/action gains are not LightSem effect sizes. Compare ordered clips with order-destroyed controls, and measure actual VRAM and feature cache cost first.

Verified full PDF SHA256 b40580916242ade00e2ac177cb01473d511f021d5a25f7552fd17512b3a72bbb. Read scope: Abstract; Sec2.3 dense and deep supervision; Sec3.10 distilled models/Table11; conclusion; official80M Base384 release. Published evidence is outside LightSem; application here is a hypothesis.
